utility.notes: SCE's own 'Incorporated Cities and Counties Served by SCE' fact sheet (updated 3/17/2025) explicitly lists 'Walnut' by name among the cities in its service area. (This is the City of Walnut in Los Angeles County, distinct from Walnut Creek in Contra Costa County.)

value.name: Southern California Edison (SCE)
value.notes: Clean Power Alliance's own homepage states it serves '38 communities across Los Angeles and Ventura counties' and names each one individually via its site's community directory; Walnut is not among the named communities. No other Los Angeles/Ventura County CCA serving Walnut was found, so Southern California Edison (SCE) is recorded as both the distribution and generation utility.

county.notes: Walnut is a well-documented Los Angeles County city; also listed under Los Angeles County in SCE's own service-area fact sheet.

permit_authority.notes: Directly re-verified via browser this session (an earlier HTTP 403 to automated fetch was intermittent, not a persistent block).

interconnection_url.notes: SCE's own Net Energy Metering (NEM) program page — a utility-wide fact already established for other SCE-territory records this session.

value.name: SGIP - Residential Solar and Storage Equity
value.administrator: Southern California Edison (SCE), under the CPUC's Self-Generation Incentive Program
value.description: Storage incentive of $1,100/kWh paired with a solar incentive of $3,100/kW, funded via a $280 million CPUC-authorized budget that opened for reservations June 2, 2025. Administered by SCE across its entire distribution territory, which includes Walnut/Los Angeles County.
value.eligibility: PG&E or SCE residential customers (general market tier)

battery_programs.notes: Same statewide CPUC-administered SGIP program already confirmed for other SCE-territory records this session, reused as a utility-level fact.

required_documents.notes: walnutca.gov returned HTTP 403 to automated fetch on every attempt this session, blocking access to any solar-specific submittal requirements.

value: Call (909) 598-5241 and leave a voicemail with the project address, contact information, and type of inspection
inspection_steps.notes: This is the City's general Building & Safety inspection-request process (the same page covers all building permit types, including solar); the City does not publish a separate, solar-specific inspection sequence.

value.program_or_pathway: Expedited Small Residential Rooftop Solar Energy Systems permitting (implementing AB 2188)
other_conditions: System must be installed on a single- or duplex-family dwelling
Panel/module array must not exceed the maximum legal building height per the Walnut Municipal Code
System must conform to all applicable state fire, structural, and electrical codes as adopted by the City

permit_fees.notes: The City publishes a dedicated 'Solar System Fee Schedule' PDF, but it triggers a file-download dialog rather than a viewable page and could not be read this session (confirmed dead end, not retried further).
